parameters.content:
## Recover abandoned Shopify checkouts

### How it works
Find one eligible checkout, wait, and recheck conversion and inventory before rendering a personalized video. Optional recovery emails include its link. A later recheck prevents follow-up after conversion or other disqualifying changes.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Set shopDomain and branding in Config. manualFixture=true uses sample data and short waits; switch it off for live Shopify.
4. Attach X-Shopify-Access-Token Header Auth to all three Shopify requests. Required scopes are read_orders, read_customers and read_products, with protected checkout access. Refresh expiring tokens.
5. SMTP is optional: connect both email nodes and configure emailFrom before setting sendEmail=true.
6. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
7. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/shopify-abandoned-checkout-recovery.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Find and lock one checkout

The fixture avoids Shopify; live mode reads abandoned checkouts. One in-flight lock prevents concurrent recovery of the same checkout.

## 3. Wait and recheck eligibility

Check conversion, inventory, newer abandonment and prior Shopify email before rendering. Ineligible checkouts stop here.

## 4. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 5. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 6. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 7. Deliver the initial recovery message

Email, phone and the recovery URL stay out of the video payload. Enable SMTP delivery only after a private test.

## 8. Recheck before any follow-up

After the optional delay, check Shopify again. The fixture can simulate conversion to demonstrate that follow-up stops.

nodes.name: 9. Stop after conversion or deliver once

parameters.content:
## 9. Stop after conversion or deliver once

Skip the follow-up when the checkout is no longer eligible. Record handling after the optional final email.

## 10. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
